blocks.prompt: 5. Given \(f(x) = x^3 - ax^2 + bx + 1\). If \(f(2) = -3\) and \(f(-1) = 0\). Find the values of \(a\) and \(b\).
blocks.explanation:
Is function ke rule mein do na-maloom constants (fixed numbers) \(a\) aur \(b\) hain, aur humein function ki do values di gayi hain.
Diya kya hai? \(f(2) = -3\) aur \(f(-1) = 0\).
Find kya karna hai? \(a\) aur \(b\).
Plan: har di hui value se ek equation banana; do equations se do unknowns nikal aate hain. Phir elimination method se hal.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(f(x) = x^3 - ax^2 + bx + 1\), \(f(2) = -3\), \(f(-1) = 0\).
Humein find karna hai: \(a\) aur \(b\).
Tareeqa: \(f(2) = -3\) ka matlab hai ke rule mein \(x = 2\) rakhein to jawab \(-3\) aana chahiye. Is se ek equation milegi. Isi tarah \(f(-1) = 0\) se doosri. Phir do linear equations ko jama kar ke ek unknown khatam karenge.

\(f(2) = -3\) se equation
\[f(2) = 8 - 4a + 2b + 1\]
\[9 - 4a + 2b = -3\]
\[-4a + 2b = -12\]
\[2a - b = 6 \quad (1)\]
Kyun: \(2^3 = 8\), \(a \cdot 2^2 = 4a\), \(b \cdot 2 = 2b\). Phir 9 ko doosri taraf le gaye (\(-3 - 9 = -12\)). Aakhir mein poori equation ko \(-2\) se divide kiya taake numbers chhote aur signs seedhe ho jayein; is se jawab nahi badalta.

\(f(-1) = 0\) se equation
\[f(-1) = -1 - a - b + 1\]
\[-a - b = 0\]
\[a + b = 0 \quad (2)\]
Kyun: \((-1)^3 = -1\) (odd power par minus rehta hai), \((-1)^2 = +1\) (even power par plus), is liye \(-a(-1)^2 = -a\). Aur \(b(-1) = -b\). \(-1\) aur \(+1\) cancel ho gaye.
Dhyan dein: \((-1)^2\) ko \(-1\) likhna yahan sab se aam ghalti hai.

(1) aur (2) jama karein
\[3a = 6 \Rightarrow a = 2\]
Kyun: (1) mein \(-b\) aur (2) mein \(+b\) hai. Jama karne se \(b\) khatam ho gaya; isi ko elimination method kehte hain. Phir 3 se divide kiya.

\(b\) nikalein
\[2 + b = 0 \Rightarrow b = -2\]
Kyun: \(a = 2\) ko aasaan wali equation (2) mein rakha. Hamesha aasaan equation chunein, ghalti ka chance kam hota hai.

Tasdeeq: \(f(x) = x^3 - 2x^2 - 2x + 1\)
\[f(2) = 8 - 8 - 4 + 1 = -3 \;\checkmark\]
\[f(-1) = -1 - 2 + 2 + 1 = 0 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: \(a\) aur \(b\) rakh kar poora function likha aur dono di hui values check kin. Dono theek aayin. Dhyan rahe: \(-ax^2\) mein \(a = 2\) rakhne se \(-2x^2\), aur \(bx\) mein \(b = -2\) se \(-2x\) banta hai.
